title: Component Creation Uses Wizard Answers
summary: Component creation must use the current wizard schema and answers.json flow instead of obsolete create commands.
agent_instruction: When creating a Greentic component, first capture the current schema, create an answers.json file, then run the wizard with --answers. Do not use remembered component create shortcuts.
human_summary: The authoritative component creation path is schema and answers driven.

new_capabilities.title: Component Answers Flow
new_capabilities.summary: Create components from a checked answers.json file that matches the current wizard schema.

deprecated_commands.reason: Old shorthand commands do not capture the current wizard contract.
Component authoring is now schema and answers driven.

replaced_guidance.old_guidance: Create a component with a one-shot component create command.
replaced_guidance.replacement_guidance: Capture schema, write answers.json, apply the wizard answers flow, then run component QA.
replaced_guidance.reason: The schema-backed answers file is the reviewable contract for current component creation.

migration_steps.instruction: Capture the current component wizard schema.
Apply a reviewed answers.json file through the wizard.
